environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at namespace level via label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted'. Container runs with runAsNonRoot: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and drops ALL capabilities. Volume is an emptyDir with 50Mi sizeLimit projected into /data. Each pod's service account has an annotation 'iam.amazonaws.com/permitted' scoped to its own tenant prefix in the backing object store. The Istio sidecar enforces mTLS STRICT mode with AuthorizationPolicy requiring request.auth.claims[sub] to match a per-tenant SPIFFE identity, and a custom EnvoyFilter at the SIDECAR_INBOUND chain applies a Lua script that extracts the JWT 'sub' claim and injects it as X-Verified-Owner header, which the application trusts for ownership validation when present (falling back to X-User-ID only if X-Verified-Owner is absent).

config.istio_authorization_policy: require request.auth.claims[sub] matches tenant SPIFFE ID
config.envoy_filter: Lua script injects X-Verified-Owner from JWT sub claim at SIDECAR_INBOUND
